name: Status Update
description: Progress, upcoming work and risks, ready to paste into a report or message.
outline: Summarize the overall status in one sentence, and say if the speaker described it as on track, at risk or blocked.
List what was completed since the last update.
List risks, blockers and anything the speaker needs from others, with names if given.
Keep it short and scannable; use plain bullets.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Status
On track for the 15 June launch.

## Risks & Needs
- Waiting on legal review
